prompt: show companies with pe > 15 or promoter holding less than 40
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.company_name FROM symbol s JOIN fundamentals f ON s.symbol_id = f.symbol_id  WHERE f.pe > %s OR f.promoter_holding < %s LIMIT 20

prompt: Show companies with promoter holding less than 30 and EBITDA in the last 3 quarters greater than 1000000
sql:
SELECT s.company_name FROM symbol s JOIN fundamentals f ON s.symbol_id = f.symbol_id JOIN historical_metrics h ON s.symbol_id = h.symbol_id  WHERE f.promoter_holding < %s AND h.ebitda > %s
                AND h.reported_date >=
                CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '9 months'
                 LIMIT 20
